policy.promotion_rule: No plugin result becomes a released engineering fact without source validation and Data Center registration.

plugins.name: Tavily
plugins.engineering_use: Find current official pages and documentation; preserve original URLs.

plugins.name: Firecrawl
plugins.engineering_use: Extract manufacturer pages and documentation for controlled review.

plugins.name: Scite
plugins.engineering_use: Support methodology and technical literature reviews; not primary source for manufacturer ratings.

plugins.name: Wolfram
plugins.engineering_use: Independent mathematical support for volume, area, clearances, utilization, battery/thermal/electrical calculations and geometric checks. Inputs must come from controlled engineering sources.

plugins.name: Airtable
plugins.engineering_use: Optional operational mirror/index; GitHub Data Center remains canonical.

plugins.name: Notion
plugins.engineering_use: Optional documentation layer; canonical project records stay in GitHub.

plugins.name: Acumen by Talarion
plugins.engineering_use: Advisory detector only. Every surfaced fact requires independent verification.

plugins.name: Engram
role: semantic retrieval of prior project context
plugins.engineering_use: Store and retrieve non-sensitive project context, decisions and methodology snapshots. GitHub Data Center/Data Sheet/LI-BOM remain canonical engineering authority.
plugins.fail_safe_rule: If Engram write/search is unavailable, continue using GitHub canonical memory and project files without weakening engineering gates.

plugins.name: to3D
plugins.engineering_use: Use only as supplemental visualization or rough mesh generation from a reference image. Never use generated mesh as dimensional authority for cabinet/components.

plugins.name: Adobe
plugins.engineering_use: Use after engineering geometry/render is frozen, for visual cleanup and presentation only. It may not alter engineering geometry, quantities, dimensions or tags.

deterministic_geometry_authority: Blender for rendering only after geometry lock

plugin_support.to3D: visual/concept mesh from images; not dimensional authority
plugin_support.ImageGen: illustrative/render support only; never engineering geometry authority

geometry_and_image_stack.hard_rule: Generated 3D/image tools cannot change the frozen engineering geometry or prove component dimensions.
